analysis.diagonal_approximation: preserve every x-y-z marginal variance and set off-diagonal entries to zero
analysis.factor_diagnostic: remove the smallest eigenvalue as an isotropic floor, retain the leading positive eigencomponent, and return omitted variance to the diagonal so marginal variances remain exact
analysis.primary_covariance: frozen horizon scale times donor future covariance plus common isotropic observation variance
analysis.primary_endpoint: equal-case mean of minus-one-half-log-determinant of each 3x3 correlation matrix
analysis.secondary_covariance: raw donor future covariance plus common isotropic observation variance

claim_boundary: This target-free retrospective diagnostic can quantify the Gaussian dependence encoded inside each exported 3x3 point covariance. It cannot establish realized log-score superiority, joint whole-object tolerance value, regularized-empirical-covariance superiority, cross-track dependence, physical-cause identification, fresh transfer, or a Bayesian-specific paper claim.
scientific_question: Does the frozen covariance-only donor contain enough same-marginal Gaussian dependence to motivate a separately frozen realized-value comparison, and is that dependence locally rank-one compressible?
